example.title: Victory Highway, One Mile Segment West of West Wendover: culverts (Features 8 and 9)

brief: Early 1920s transcontinental-highway culverts: a paired culvert of two round concrete pipes about 2 ft in diameter set side by side in a low, plain cast-concrete headwall flush with the road shoulder, and a single-pipe culvert with a small concrete headwall, both half-buried in sandy fill under the old two-lane roadbed in sagebrush desert. Very plain and low; no railing. For the Bellhaven highway crossing, set the same paired-pipe headwall in a grassy ditch.
